title: Assurance Wave: End-to-End Delivery Plan for SSO/SAML & Audit Log Controls (SOC2/ISO Alignment)
creator: Eleanor Park
description:
Objective: Deliver a scoped, auditable set of controls and artifacts that satisfy SOC2/ISO alignment for SSO (SAML/SCIM) and audit logging. This ticket coordinates product, engineering, security, and legal to produce implementation code, configuration guidance, evidence artifacts, and acceptance criteria for the April release.

Scope:
- SSO: SAML single sign-on integration, SCIM user provisioning baseline, documented RBAC mappings for admin/engineer tiers.
- Audit Logs: Immutable event stream for authentication/authorization events, configurable retention policy, export for auditors, retention proof.
- Controls Mapping: Map implemented features to SOC2 common criteria and ISO 27001 Annex A controls.

Out-of-scope: Full multi-IDP federation beyond core SAML flows and long-term analytics platform for logs (that will be handled by separate Observability initiative).
milestones: Milestone 1 - Design & Control Mapping completed (owner: Product) - target 2026-03-05 - status: done
Milestone 2 - SSO implementation PR + integration tests (owner: ENG-auth) - target 2026-03-20 - status: in progress
Milestone 3 - Audit log pipeline & export endpoints (owner: ENG-logging) - target 2026-03-28 - status: planned
Milestone 4 - Evidence artifacts & runbook for auditors (owner: Security & PM) - target 2026-04-05 - status: planned
Milestone 5 - Internal pre-audit & security review (owner: Security) - target 2026-04-10 - status: planned
acceptance_criteria: SAML SSO flow passes end-to-end automated test with 2 IdP types and documented attribute mappings.
SCIM provisioning supports create/update/deprovision and is covered by unit and integration tests.
Audit log events include immutable timestamped records for all auth-related actions, schema documented and exportable as NDJSON/CSV.
Retention policy configurable per-org with an auditor-visible retention proof export and deletion log.
Control matrix mapping maps each deliverable to SOC2 and ISO clauses and is stored in Confluence as evidence.
comments: 2026-03-02 - Sync note: Kickoff with ENG-auth and ENG-logging. Agreed to use existing event schema v2 as baseline; ENG-logging to add immutability header. Action: ENG-logging to submit design doc by 2026-03-06.
2026-03-04 - PM review: Legal flagged retention exceptions for EU customers; added requirement for per-region retention config and export. Liam to validate infra feasibility with infra lead.
2026-03-09 - Design review: UX provided wireframes for admin retention controls and audit download flow. Design feedback requires clarification on RBAC labels for 'auditor' role (DES-401).

2026-03-11 - Security note: Data classification review recommends masking PII in audit events; decision: keep event skeleton with hashed identifiers. Security to publish redaction pattern (expected 2026-03-15).

2026-03-12 - Progress: ENG-auth opened PR #1083 for SAML connector and basic SCIM handlers (https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/1083). CI passing for unit tests; integration tests pending due to mock IdP setup.
risk_and_mitigation: Risks: EU retention requirements may conflict with a single global retention policy; mock IdP instability causing integration test flakiness; timeline squeeze with parallel SSO and logging work. Mitigations: add per-region retention config (low-effort toggle), create deterministic local IdP test harness, and negotiate a soft freeze on noncritical features for the April release window.
notes_for_release: Do not ship retention >90 days as default for EU orgs without Legal sign-off. Release checklist to include auditor access test, evidence bundle export, and migration plan for orgs with legacy logs. Post-release: 30-day evidence collection window before initiating external audit.
